name: OPSWAT MetaDefender Cloud API (hash lookups)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8 trusted): 'Registry tiers: Recorded Future, OPSWAT and PolySwarm trusted; MalShare and VirusShare community.' (P177 cond 6).

reliability.justification: Multi-engine AV scan results for a hash; one OPSWAT vote together with Filescan (same vendor, upstream family 'opswat', P177 cond 5, P178 cond 4).

metadefender.description: OPSWAT MetaDefender Cloud API key (apikey header)
metadefender.plan_hint: the free key is licensed 'solely for Your personal use' (noncommercial); corporate use needs a paid MetaDefender plan recorded by legal (licence_allow) (P177 cond 3/4); X-RateLimit-* headers report the plan's allowance

hash_lookup.title: MetaDefender Cloud v4 hash lookup (/v4/hash/{md5|sha1|sha256}, metadata only)

terms.quote: Licence (legal floor, verified 2026-11-26): Triage's free Individual/Researcher licences are non-commercial and make analyses public, so corporate use needs a commercial Triage licence; OPSWAT licenses free use 'solely for Your personal use', so MetaDefender needs a paid plan.

hash_lookup.notes: Quote: binding council text (P177 cond 3). Research C0416 (verified_needs_key, 401). GET https://api.metadefender.com/v4/hash/{hash} with the apikey header; never built: file upload (POST /v4/file), scan results by data_id, sanitized-file downloads and any /download path (P177 cond 2). 404 (code 404003) = hash unknown; 429 with X-RateLimit-Remaining 0 and a reset of an hour or more = daily allowance exhausted (QUOTA), else RATE_LIMITED. Upstream family 'opswat' so MetaDefender and Filescan count once in consensus (P177 cond 5, P171). The research endpoint host api.metadefender.com was unowned; the web result pages (metadefender.com) stay with provider metadefender. Batch p3-G07-2, module metadefender.
hash_lookup.licensed_alternative: A paid MetaDefender Cloud plan recorded by legal as a licence_allow entry for this source (P177 cond 3/4: the paid plan is 'key-terms'); the manual MetaDefender result pages (metadefender.result_pages) stay available.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G07-2 (P177, module metadefender). A separate fragment from 'metadefender' (manual result pages, batch p2-G14-3) because provider extensions cannot add keys and the adapter needs its own key (P177 cond 1). Terms 'noncommercial' (free key): off under the corporate profile until legal records a paid plan; default_enabled False.
